from PIL import Image
import numpy as np
from collections import deque
im=np.array(Image.open('first_frame.png').convert('RGB'))
R,G,B=im.T
mask=((R<45)&(G<45)&(B<45)).T
h,w=mask.shape
seen=np.zeros_like(mask,bool)
comps=[]
for y in range(h):
 for x in range(w):
  if mask[y,x] and not seen[y,x]:
   q=[(y,x)]; seen[y,x]=1; pts=[]
   while q:
    cy,cx=q.pop(); pts.append((cy,cx))
    for dy in (-1,0,1):
     for dx in (-1,0,1):
      if dy==0 and dx==0: continue
      ny,nx=cy+dy,cx+dx
      if 0<=ny<h and 0<=nx<w and mask[ny,nx] and not seen[ny,nx]:
       seen[ny,nx]=1;q.append((ny,nx))
   ys=[p[0] for p in pts]; xs=[p[1] for p in pts]
   comps.append((len(pts),(min(xs),min(ys),max(xs),max(ys))))
print(sorted(comps,reverse=True)[:10])
# print kettle region row x ranges
for y in range(0,75,5):
 xs=np.where(mask[y,100:190])[0]+100
 if len(xs):
  # contiguous ranges
  ranges=[]; s=p=xs[0]
  for x in xs[1:]:
   if x>p+1:ranges.append((s,p));s=x
   p=x
  ranges.append((s,p))
  print(y,ranges)
